title: Taiwan’s Foxconn says biggest challenge is U.S.-China trade war
text:
Home Technology Taiwan’s Foxconn says biggest challenge is U.S.-China trade war Taiwan’s Foxconn says biggest challenge is U.S.-China trade war June 22, 2018 admin Technology 0
TAIPEI (Reuters) – Foxconn ( 2317.TW ), the world’s largest electronics contract producer, mentioned on Friday the largest problem the corporate is going through is the commerce struggle between Washington and Beijing. FILE PHOTO: The brand of Foxconn, the buying and selling identify of Hon Hai Precision Industry, is seen on high of the corporate’s constructing in Taipei, Taiwan March 30, 2018. REUTERS/Tyrone Siu/File Photo
President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to hit $200 billion of Chinese imports with 10 % tariffs if Beijing retaliates towards his earlier announcement to focus on $50 billion in imports. The United States has accused China of stealing U.S. mental property, a cost Beijing denies.
“The biggest challenge we’re facing is the U.S.-China trade war. In terms of how we manage and adapt, this is something all our high-level managers are making various plans on,” Chairman Terry Gou mentioned on the firm’s annual normal assembly. FILE PHOTO: A motorcyclist rides previous the emblem of Foxconn, the buying and selling identify of Hon Hai Precision Industry, in Taipei, Taiwan March 30, 2018. REUTERS/Tyrone Siu/File Photo
He didn’t elaborate on what sort of plans had been into consideration.
A Sino-U.S. commerce struggle may disrupt provide chains for the expertise and auto industries, sectors closely reliant on outsourced elements, and derail progress for the world financial system.
The United States and China are Taiwan’s high export markets.
Foxconn, a significant provider for Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ), is formally generally known as Hon Hai Precision Industry Co.
For 2018, Gou mentioned it was essential to be conscious of the uncertainties of inflation and the tempo of rate of interest rises, including that the Chinese financial system continues to be affected by “structural adjustments”.
Shares of Foxconn had been down 0.7 % on Friday, in step with the benchmark index .TWII . Reporting by Jess Macy Yu; Editing by Anne Marie Roantree and Edwina Gibbs
